title: Extended Euclidean Algorithm as Computable Function

problemStatement.formal: Define extGcd : N -> N -> Z x Z x N by well-founded recursion implementing the extended Euclidean algorithm, and prove (1) extGcd(a,b).g = gcd(a,b), (2) a * extGcd(a,b).x + b * extGcd(a,b).y = extGcd(a,b).g, with full computability (no axioms, no sorry).
problemStatement.plain: Formalize the extended Euclidean algorithm as a computable function in Lean 4 with a machine-checked correctness proof that it returns valid Bezout coefficients.
whyMatters: Demonstrates formalization of a fundamental algorithm with correctness proof
Provides computable Bezout coefficients (not just existence)
Extends the existing BezoutIdentity gallery proof with algorithmic content

proven: extGcd_gcd: (extGcd a b).2.2 = Nat.gcd a b
extGcd_bezout: a * (extGcd a b).1 + b * (extGcd a b).2.1 = (extGcd a b).2.2
extGcd_correct: a * x + b * y = gcd(a,b) via extGcd
extGcd_gcd_pos: gcd > 0 when a or b nonzero
bezout_via_extGcd: existence of Bezout coefficients via computable function
